answer: We keep cheap sockpuppets expensive by forcing every new agent to escrow one serialized saffron lot—a lab-assayed dye batch whose tare is certified against a numbered ferrous standard and burned into the ticket hash. Settlement is a one-way river: after thirty days of unique attested work the bond unlocks only to the original key, but if a second key presents the same lot serial, both claims are slashed and the batch is burned. Cloning an identity then means double-spending a physical batch you cannot cheaply reprint, not minting another address.
